rows.grounds: compound nāka-sthāḥ with enclitic ca; denotes those residing in nāka
expresses movement or attainment of destination
compound denoting those residing in svarga
mokṣam as object with optative verb indicating potential attainment

items.question: What distinct posthumous attainments await dwellers of nāka versus dwellers of svarga?
premises: Those dwelling in nāka go to divam.
Those dwelling in svarga may obtain mokṣa.
Different celestial abodes correspond to different posthumous outcomes.
items.inference: Dwellers of nāka and dwellers of svarga are assigned distinct posthumous destinations.
uncertainties: The precise distinction between nāka, divam, and svarga in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Those who dwell in nāka go to heaven, while those who dwell in svarga may obtain liberation.
